title: Better Radioactive
description: Adds Uranium ore, blocks, and radioactive potion effects. A vanilla-plus tech mod for NeoForge 1.21.8 aiming for realistic nuclear energy.
body:
Better Radioactive is a vanilla-plus technology mod that introduces uranium and radioactive mechanics to Minecraft. Currently in Beta, this mod aims to expand the periodic table and bring realistic nuclear energy to your world.

​✨ Current Features (v1.0.0 Beta)
​Uranium Ore: A new ore found deep underground.
​
Processing: Smelt Uranium Ore into Uranium Ingots or craft them into Uranium Blocks.

​Radioactivity: Handling these materials without protection (coming soon) or being near them can apply the Radioactive Potion Effect.

​Potions: New Radioactive Potions that utilize the power of uranium.

​🛠️ Technical Details
​Mod Loader: NeoForge
​Minecraft Version:1.21.8
​Created with: MCreator

​📅 Future Roadmap
​I am actively developing this mod! Future updates will include:

​More Elements: Adding more materials from the periodic table.
​
Nuclear Reactors: A realistic multi-block reactor system.

​Energy System: Full power generation support (FE/Energy).

​Bug Fixes: Regular polish and community-reported fixes.
